d: Varicose veins develop when veins in the legs become enlarged and twisted, often because their valves do not move blood efficiently back towards the heart. Gravity, prolonged sitting or standing, family history, ageing and hormonal changes can all play a role. Regular movement and appropriate care can help manage symptoms and support healthier circulation. In this video, Hansaji explains practical ways to improve leg movement, reduce heaviness and build habits that support venous health.
